flows.title: Create an S3 bucket
steps: Open the Amazon S3 console. In the navigation bar, choose the name of the currently displayed AWS Region, then choose the Region for the bucket. A bucket's Region cannot be changed after it is created.
In the left navigation pane, choose General purpose buckets, then choose Create bucket. The Create bucket page opens.
For Bucket name, enter a name for the bucket. It must be unique within the partition and between 3 and 63 characters long.
Under Block Public Access settings for this bucket, keep all four settings enabled unless the use case needs one of them turned off.

flows.title: Turn on versioning for an S3 bucket
steps: Open the Amazon S3 console, and in the left navigation pane choose General purpose buckets.
In the buckets list, choose the name of the bucket.
Choose Properties, and under Bucket Versioning choose Edit.
Choose Enable, or Suspend to stop versioning, and then choose Save changes.
